method: Hand-tagged content of the top Google ads by spend: what the creative is about, 1-3 issues from the frozen taxonomy, first is primary. The tagger watched/read the creative at creative_url (YouTube captions of the embedded video, the on-screen text of text ads, or video frames). Ads whose creative names no issue in the taxonomy (fundraising asks, biography, residency, trans-athlete spots) are left untagged on purpose.
